notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.5
notes.notes:
This patch contains bug fixes.

[[b]FIXED[/b]] Fatal error on Windows 11 upon launching the game.
[[b]FIXED[/b]] Sometimes unable to spawn at the beginning of the match.
[[b]FIXED[/b]] Sometimes sensitivity won't save.
[[b]FIXED[/b]] Wrong amount being added after payment for premiums (affected players have been refunded the missing amount)

[[b]IMPROVED[/b]] Menu buttons are now more responsive.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
This update aims to improve a few sections in [b]LIGHTNING[/b], including the Map Editor

[h3]Map Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Curser not showing on the PUBLISH MAP page
[*] Extra meshes show up when loading a new map multiple times
[*] Button to hide visible function flags for screenshot purposes
[/list]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] New inspect animation for Karambit
[/list]

[h3]Horde Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Horde Mode: Mutants will get pushed back when under fire
[/list]

[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] New character and voice in radio comms
[*] New voice for operators
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing the INTERACT button in any mode will bring up the Map Editor
[*] Rare crashes that happen in Plant-&-Defuse-based modes
[/list]


[h2]All the best in 2024[/h2]
Stay tuned for more intel.
